notes: THE UNIT-SCALING ANCHOR. North BB Creek Townhouses block N, units 54-61: ONE building of EIGHT townhouse units in a 19-sheet combined residential set (arch + MEP + structural). Only the representative units are annotated (54/61 end units, 55/56 interior); units 57-60 are drawn blank, so a correct BOM multiplies per-unit symbol counts x8. The electrical content is symbols on the MEP plan sheets (A9-A11) and the text layer carries almost none of it, so the pipeline escalates to vision on the three electrical sheets. Sheet A16 is a generic symbol legend ('ALL SYMBOLS MAY NOT APPLY') and must not become BOM lines; the panel schedule is deferred to E-sheets NOT in this PDF, so the only panel/service items are the ones the electrical notes (A11) require per unit. Quantities below are the whole-building anchors ground-truthed by vision agents over page tiles on 2026-07-22 (see memory: extraction-test-fixtures) and carry wide tolerances because they are symbol counts. Per-unit counts that were NOT scaled (a got/want ratio near 1/8) are the failure this document exists to catch; the bench reports them as scale_errors.
